author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Does Adam Savage have any unique encounters with fans while flying, and what are his best travel tips? How does Adam manage frustration when it impacts his creative process? Is Adam the exception to the rule: "Don't turn your hobby into your job"? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from ryan_j_peck, JustinMatulonis, brianbaker2455 and the_gr8_brandino, whom we thank for their support! What are your best travel tips and stories?
